fields.Name: AIUsageCacheEfficiency
fields.UserQuestion: What is our prompt caching hit rate and estimated cost savings across models and prompts?
fields.Description: Prompt cache efficiency per model and prompt (and currency): cache read volume, cache read share, and estimated savings priced at the token rate in effect when each run executed, with a count of runs that could not be rated.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Groups vwAIUsageFacts by ModelID, PromptID and CostCurrency (parallel parents excluded). Each run is priced by the AIModelCost row in effect at RunAt (StartedAt <= RunAt < EndedAt, Active or Expired, Realtime) matched on model, vendor and currency, restricted to token-billed unit types (AIModelPriceUnitType.UsageTypeID = Tokens) and divided by UnitsPerBillingUnit. Runs with no matching rate or a NULL CacheReadPricePerUnit are excluded from EstimatedSavings and counted in UnratedRuns / UnratedTokensCacheRead. Optional start/end filter the base RunAt column.

fields.Name: start
fields.Description: Optional start date filter for the run timestamp (RunAt). Guarded by truthiness check.

fields.Name: end
fields.Description: Optional end date filter for the run timestamp (RunAt). Guarded by truthiness check.

fields.Name: ModelID
fields.Description: The ID of the AI model used

fields.Name: PromptID
fields.Description: The ID of the prompt used

fields.Name: Runs
fields.ComputationDescription: COUNT(*) aggregate counting the total runs

fields.Name: TokensCacheRead
fields.Description: Sum of tokens read from cache

fields.Name: CacheReadShare
fields.Description: The proportion of prompt tokens that were read from cache

fields.Name: EstimatedSavings
fields.Description: Estimated cost savings from cache reads

fields.Name: RatedRuns
fields.Description: Number of runs where cache read savings could be calculated
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN TokensCacheRead > 0 AND CacheReadPricePerUnit IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: UnratedRuns
fields.Description: Number of runs with cache reads that could not be rated due to missing price
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN TokensCacheRead > 0 AND CacheReadPricePerUnit IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: UnratedTokensCacheRead
fields.Description: Sum of cache read tokens that could not be rated
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN CacheReadPricePerUnit IS NULL THEN TokensCacheRead ELSE 0 END)
